name: Paper Manuscript
tagline: paper-algorithm's manuscript: cream paper, ink serif, one vermilion accent and a secondary ink-blue, ink-drop entrances.

motion.direction: paper-algorithm manuscript. Scientific paper on cream: Playfair 900 serif headings in sentence case, data in JetBrains Mono with tabular figures, full-sentence ink captions where the sentence's keyword turns vermilion `ter`. Vermilion is the ONLY accent (max 2 per frame, one focus at a time); ink-blue `goldd` only for annotations and guide lines. Three signatures, never repeating an entrance within a scene: ink-drop (rise 40–80 px, power3.out 0.5–0.8 s), brush-write (scale 0.2 → 1 with 3–6° rotation), seal-stamp (`stamp` 1.4 → 1, back.out). One accent every 8–15 s, scenes 5–15 s, nothing static over 3 s, no hard cuts, no exits except the last scene. A red seal `stamp` top-right on the final card.
